description: Paid web search via x402 ($0.004 USDC on base). Pass an x402 payment in the X-PAYMENT header of the MCP request, or send header X-Trial: 1 for free trial calls (25 per network). Free tier: up to 20 calls a day with no payment or key (10 results per call). Supports freshness (hour/day/week/month/year), dateFrom/dateTo, page and num up to 100.
name: web_search
title: Web search (free tier, then x402)
